# events.variable.EventVariable { #fmrimod.events.variable.EventVariable }

```python
EventVariable(
    name,
    onsets,
    values,
    durations=0,
    center=True,
    scale=False,
    nan_strategy='drop',
)
```

Continuous event with numeric values.

This represents events with continuous values (ratings, reaction times,
parametric modulators, etc.) in an fMRI experiment.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                    | Description                                                    | Default    |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| name      | [str](`str`)                                            | Name of the event                                              | _required_ |
| onsets    | [array](`array`) - [like](`like`)                       | Event onset times                                              | _required_ |
| values    | [array](`array`) - [like](`like`)                       | Continuous values for each event                               | _required_ |
| durations | [scalar](`scalar`) or [array](`array`) - [like](`like`) | Event durations. If scalar, used for all events. Default is 0. | `0`        |
| center    | [bool](`bool`)                                          | Whether to center values (subtract mean). Default is True.     | `True`     |
| scale     | [bool](`bool`)                                          | Whether to scale values (divide by std). Default is False.     | `False`    |

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name       | Type                           | Description                               |
|------------|--------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| values     | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Numeric values (possibly centered/scaled) |
| raw_values | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Original values before centering/scaling  |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Simple continuous event
>>> event = EventVariable(
...     name='rating',
...     onsets=[1, 2, 3, 4],
...     values=[7.5, 3.2, 8.1, 5.5]
... )
>>> 
>>> # With scaling and custom durations
>>> event = EventVariable(
...     name='reaction_time',
...     onsets=[1, 2, 3, 4],
...     values=[0.5, 0.8, 0.3, 0.6],
...     durations=[1, 1, 2, 1],
...     center=True,
...     scale=True
... )
```

### bin_values { #fmrimod.events.variable.EventVariable.bin_values }

```python
bin_values(n_bins=3, labels=None)
```

Convert to categorical by binning values.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                           | Default   |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| n_bins | [int](`int`) | Number of bins                                        | `3`       |
| labels | list of str  | Labels for bins. If None, uses Low/Medium/High style. | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                          |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | [EventFactor](`fmrimod.events.factor.EventFactor`) | Categorical event with binned values |

### design_matrix { #fmrimod.events.variable.EventVariable.design_matrix }

```python
design_matrix(sampling_points)
```

Generate design matrix column for this event.

Creates a single column with the continuous values at event times.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                           | Description                | Default    |
|-----------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------|------------|
| sampling_points | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Time points to evaluate at | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                   |
|--------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | [Array](`fmrimod.types.Array`) | Design matrix column, shape (n_timepoints, 1) |

### from_dataframe { #fmrimod.events.variable.EventVariable.from_dataframe }

```python
from_dataframe(
    df,
    name,
    onset_col='onset',
    value_col=None,
    duration_col='duration',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Create EventVariable from DataFrame.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                           | Description                                  | Default      |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|--------------|
| df           | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | DataFrame containing event data              | _required_   |
| name         | [str](`str`)                                   | Name for the event                           | _required_   |
| onset_col    | [str](`str`)                                   | Column name for onsets                       | `'onset'`    |
| value_col    | [str](`str`)                                   | Column name for values. If None, uses name.  | `None`       |
| duration_col | [str](`str`)                                   | Column name for durations                    | `'duration'` |
| **kwargs     | [object](`object`)                             | Additional arguments passed to EventVariable | `{}`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                     | Description                |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
|        | [EventVariable](`fmrimod.events.variable.EventVariable`) | New EventVariable instance |
